results.title: Marcos to councilors: Legislate with purpose; be mindful of ordinary Filipinos' concerns
results.description: President Marcos has urged councilors in the country to create effective ordinances and reminded them to "remain closely attuned" to the concerns of ordinary Filipinos. In his speech at the oath-taking ceremony for newly elected national, regional, and island officers of the Philippine Councilors League, Marcos stressed that councilors are among the public officials closest to communities. "Councilors are amongst the public officials that are closest to the communities that you serve, and therefore you must remain closely attuned to the concerns of ordinary Filipinos," Marcos said during the ceremony held at Malacañan Palace on Aug. 18. "Let us legislate with purpose, not just for the sake of passing ordinances," Marcos told them. "Let us remember that effective legislation requires both principle and practicality," the President further said. Marcos also enjoined councilors to continue strengthening coordination between local governments and the national government. He emphasized that stronger coordination is needed so that assistance reaches people more quickly and effectively. The Chief Executive assured them that the national government will continue to support local government units (LGUs) through the Local Government Support Fund (LGSF) and the Social Civic Projects Fund to strengthen basic services and assist communities with limited resources. "Remember, we are one government, and our purpose is to serve the Filipino people," he said. Malacañang released the video of the oath-taking ceremony on Monday, Aug. 24.
